question: Should OpenClaw adopt RFC #27’s experimental core Claw lifecycle and merge this workspace-file ownership slice as part of that stack?
rationale: The patch is a new core CLI, filesystem, provenance, and SQLite lifecycle contract; code review cannot decide whether that permanent product surface belongs in core.

options.title: Sponsor the stack
options.body: Confirm the experimental Claw lifecycle as an intended core direction, then require final-head proof and normal stack-order review before merging this slice.

options.title: Keep the capability external
options.body: Decline the core lifecycle direction and redirect any reusable package content toward existing plugin, skill, or ClawHub surfaces.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the stack
recommendation.body: Confirm the experimental Claw lifecycle as an intended core direction, then require final-head proof and normal stack-order review before merging this slice.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment identifies the defining lifecycle and safety invariants, making them the strongest supplied routing candidate for the design decision.
